=== Kildress delegate candidate, 1793 ===

The Northern Star report of a meeting at Kildress church on 16 January 1793 names William Glasgow and Hugh Faulkner as delegates to the Dungannon meeting on parliamentary reform. William subsequently took the chair and signed the thanks resolution.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/72019090/ Northern Star, 23 January 1793, p.2].</ref> The reported birth about 1760 and Cookstown association make this a compatible identity candidate, but the notice states no age, wife, father or precise residence. It does not establish either attached relationship.
